answer: After exhausting every remaining execution option, it is DEFINITIVELY CONFIRMED that gseapy (and therefore the required gseapy enrichment against GO_Biological_Process_2021) cannot be executed in this runtime: (1) no interpreter on the system has gseapy or pydeseq2 (checked /usr/bin/python, /usr/bin/python3, /usr/bin/python3.14, the uv-managed cpython-3.12.14, and the active .actor-venv, whose site-packages contain only numpy/pandas/scipy/statsmodels/openpyxl); (2) no local caches exist (pip cache dir /tmp/cache/pip is empty/nonexistent, no ~/.cache/pip, no wheelhouses, no /var/cache/apt archives, no *.whl or *.gmt files anywhere on the filesystem); (3) no offline mirror or proxy is configured (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/PIP_INDEX_URL/UV_INDEX_URL/CONDA_PKGS_DIRS all unset); (4) there is no network path at all — DNS fails for pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, maayanlab.cloud and amp.pharm.mssm.edu ("Temporary failure in name resolution", errno -3), and even raw TCP to 1.1.1.1:443 and 151.101.128.223:443 fails with "Network is unreachable" (errno 101), so neither pip installation nor the Enrichr API (used by gseapy.enrichr to fetch GO_Biological_Process_2021) can be reached; (5) the self-bootstrapping run was retried after the diagnostics and again failed identically ("No matching distribution found for gseapy"). Because the GO_Biological_Process_2021 .gmt cannot be obtained and gseapy cannot be installed, the term with the lowest adjusted p-value is UNDETERMINED in this environment; per your instruction I have not substituted any non-gseapy enrichment tool. The full diagnostic trail is saved at results/env_diagnostic_trail.txt and summarized in results/summary.json and results/run.log. The executed analysis.py is self-bootstrapping: run unchanged in any environment with network access, it will install pydeseq2+gseapy, redo the DE (or use pydeseq2 when available), call gp.enrichr(gene_list=<127 significant symbols>, gene_sets='GO_Biological_Process_2021') and write the term with the lowest Adjusted P-value to results/enrichr_GO_Biological_Process_2021.csv and results/summary.json ("top_term"). The completed DE stage stands: Group 9 (Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50, n=3) vs Group 3 (DMSO, n=3), 16,353 genes after the ≥10-counts-in-≥3-samples filter, 432 genes at padj<0.05, 133 at padj<0.05 & |log2FC|≥1 (81 up/52 down; top hits THBS1 +2.63 padj 1.7e-44, AHRR, FOSB, ALDH1A3, CYP1A1, GDF15), 127 unique query symbols after ENSG→gene_name mapping and duplicate collapse by highest mean expression.
